what: Mean strict claim recall (share of a source's 6 claims with best entailment > 0.5) on the 24 dev sources, DeBERTa-v3-large NLI in fp32, by premise window. k = 0: whole text (cut to 512 tokens); k = 1, 2, 3: sliding windows of k sentences. Chosen: k = 2 (only setting meeting both pre-set bars: source >= 0.9, off-topic <= 0.25).
